FeaturesPage.title: Everything You Need
FeaturesPage.description: PawCal brings together all the tools you need to track your pet's health with data.
FeaturesPage.feature1LongDesc: Scan any pet food off the shelf in seconds. PawCal automatically calculates portions, tracks your daily calorie goal, and analyzes feeding history. Thousands of products supported via the Open Food Facts database.
FeaturesPage.feature2LongDesc: See real trends, not isolated data points. Every weigh-in is plotted on long-term charts with age- and breed-specific healthy ranges shown. Catch abnormal changes before they become a problem.
FeaturesPage.feature3LongDesc: Never miss your pet's medication schedule again. Set daily, weekly, or monthly reminders. Vaccine and parasite treatment schedules are reminded automatically. Generate shareable health reports for your vet.
FeaturesPage.feature4LongDesc: Set daily activity goals and earn badges as you hit them. Recommended exercise durations are shown based on breed and age. Spot sedentary days early and help prevent obesity.
FeaturesPage.feature5LongDesc: Ready when you need it — for emergencies or routine visits. Open/closed status, ratings, directions, and one-tap calling all in one place. Useful wherever you travel.
FeaturesPage.feature6LongDesc: Meet thousands of fellow pet lovers. Share photos, ask for advice, and tell your success stories. A friendly community built around Instagram-style posts and stories.

AboutPage.title: About PawCal Studio
AboutPage.story1: PawCal was born in 2026 from a real problem pet owners face: keeping track of your companion's daily health data is hard, scattered, and easy to forget. A notebook, a calendar, a calculator, and your memory — all expected to work in sync.
AboutPage.story2: At PawCal Studio, we set out to put an end to that chaos. We're doing for pet health what modern tracking apps have done for human health: a data-driven, science-backed experience that's still genuinely easy to use.
AboutPage.story3: PawCal Studio is an independent software studio dedicated to helping pet owners live more mindful, healthier lives with their companions. Built in Turkey, made for the world.
AboutPage.missionText: To help pet owners live more mindful, healthier lives alongside their companions.
AboutPage.value1Desc: Every decision is backed by data — real numbers, not guesswork.
AboutPage.value2Desc: Veterinary science is at the foundation of everything we recommend.
AboutPage.value3Desc: Your data is used solely for the well-being of you and your pet.
